body:
From the user: a full documentation review, and less fluff in the README.

Found in review (all checked against the code):
- Root README describes shopping lists only; checklists and expense lists are
  two thirds of the app now. It is also long: release.sh internals, wheel
  history and the server-URL prefill are told at length in three places.
- server/README: `admin_emails` (the only way to grant admin) appears nowhere;
  no word on deploying (init-db once for a new database) versus upgrading
  (migrations run on their own); idle session windows (web 7 days, Android
  62) undocumented; expenses section predates T-192/T-193; the update check
  omits the Settings-open check; history anecdotes (T-105, pre-1.9.0 timing).
- android/README: "Settings → Account" (now Settings → App updates), "Join list"
  (now "Join a list"), declined versions re-offered in Settings, a stale "Notes:"
  reference, changelog wording ("now says so").
- web/README: token lives in localStorage, not sessionStorage (T-104); the
  structure list misses expenses, balances, admin, i18n, format, name order.
- wire-contract: 30 of the 49 server error codes are not listed, although both
  clients translate by code; the app-version section omits the Settings check.
title: docs: full documentation review; shorter root README
